## Notes

Bohemia Interactive. Alpha 2013-03-05 on Steam Early Access, full release 2013-09-12 (Windows); macOS and Linux 2015. Weapons affected by external ballistics and recoil; carried weight reduces speed and stamina; combat vehicles, helicopters, jets, boats, diving; Eden 3D editor (2016); SQF scripting; Steam Workshop modding; terrains Tanoa 100 km2, Malden 57 km2, Livonia 163 km2; military consultants wrote after-action reports for Tac-Ops.
